Maria (AE): Heads up — Acme is asking to add live embedding-based reranking to the POC. Currently we planned batch/indexed rerank. They said it must re-rank at query time for new docs. Impact to timeline/cost?

Sam (SE): That’s a meaningful scope change. Live rerank = either compute embeddings at query time or maintain a streaming index. Need target latency and expected QPS.

Oliver (Acme): Target for the POC: represent production behavior. 95p latency <200ms, baseline throughput ~100 qps (production would be higher). For POC we'll start smaller but want the pattern. Also want an "explainability" score on each result.

Kevin (Eng): Computing embeddings per query + rerank under 200ms 95p is tough unless we use Dedicated GPUs and good batching. Alternatives: precompute index + nearline updates, or approximate sparse-first filter. Corpus size?

Maria (AE): Corpus for POC ~50k documents initial, + daily increments. POC originally scoped as 2 weeks: offline evals + basic UI.

Sam (SE): Propose explicit success criteria for alignment:
- precision@10 vs current baseline (we need numbers from Acme)
- 95p latency <= 200ms for rerank path
- end-to-end cost budget for the POC (TBD)
We also need their eval queries and prompt templates.

Oliver (Acme): We can provide a 500-query labeled eval set by EOW. Docs will include customer PII (HIPAA-adjacent).

Julia (Security): HIPAA-ish data = two options for POC: 1) synthetic/redacted data (fast), 2) Private deployment with BAA (legal/procurement, 2–4 weeks). For any live customer data we must use Private or ensure encryption + controls.

Maria (AE): Sales question: rough pricing delta if we move to live embeddings? Ballpark is fine — we just need to set expectations.

Kevin (Eng): Napkin estimate: live embeddings at 100 qps with 200ms target -> likely need reserved GPUs (Dedicated). For POC short-run we might squeeze with hosted + burst, but 95p SLAs require Dedicated. Monthly reserved cost vs per-token hosted cost — I'll put ranges.

Sam (SE): Implementation plan (quick):
- Phase 1 (week 1): offline eval—run eval set vs baseline, get precision metrics.
- Phase 2 (weeks 2–3): prototype live rerank using cached embeddings + frequent updates (reduces compute).
- Phase 3 (week 4–5): live compute path + load tests if they insist on real-time embeddings.
If they accept cached/nearline approach we can stay within original infra/time.

Maria (AE): Acme asked to extend timeline to 5 weeks to include live rerank. Can we accommodate?

Kevin (Eng): Yes but needs AE sign-off for Dedicated hardware/time. Also security decisions will affect schedule.

Julia (Security): I'll prepare a short checklist: data handling options, recommended redaction patterns, required contracts for BAA, and minimal controls for staging.

Maria (AE): Next steps: Sam produce 1-page tech note with tradeoffs + short implementation checklist; Kevin to ballpark infra cost and minimal capacity; Julia to list security options and timeline; I'll update pricing and SOW draft and sync with Acme.

Sam (SE): Quick pseudo example of the live rerank flow for the tech note:
```
# pseudo flow
# 1) get query embedding
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"user query"}' 
# 2) fetch top-k candidates from index and rerank with model
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -d '{"query_embedding":..., "candidates": [...]}')
```

Maria (AE): Oliver — can you confirm eval set delivery by Fri COB?

Oliver (Acme): Yes. We'll deliver CSV with 500 labeled queries by Friday COB.

deploy-bot: Deployment to staging succeeded for branch poc/embeddings-proto (build 314) :rocket:

Kevin (Eng): Note — the staging branch will need increased token and GPU quotas for realistic load tests.

Sam (SE): I’ll add the three success metrics to the POC doc and share the link: https://redwood.workspaces/pocs/ACME-234 (will update with tech note).

Maria (AE): Closing the loop here: timeline provisionally 5 weeks if Acme wants live compute path; cost uplift expected if Dedicated required. I’ll follow up with a formal SOW and pricing numbers. :+1:

Oliver (Acme): Thanks — appreciate the options. We’ll start with the eval set and confirm whether PII can be redacted for the first run.

Maria (AE): Great. Sam/Kevin/Julia — please post updates in this thread as you have them.

Sam (SE): Will do.

Kevin (Eng): Will post infra estimate by Tue.

Julia (Security): Sending checklist by Tue as well.

Maria (AE): Thanks everyone.
